description: This file contains unit tests for shared model modules in a TypeScript project, utilizing the Vitest testing framework. It tests functions related to configuration loading and updating, mocking external dependencies for isolation.

methods.name: loadValidConfigOrThrow
methods.description: Loads a valid configuration or throws an error if the configuration is invalid.

methods.name: updateConfig
methods.description: Updates the configuration with a provided mutation function and saves the new config.

ctags.name: cfg
ctags.pattern: /^    const cfg = { providers: {} } as unknown as OpenClawConfig;$/

ctags.name: cfg
ctags.pattern: /^    const cfg = { update: { channel: "stable" } } as unknown as OpenClawConfig;$/
